title: Dispatch: olc5.12 couple grant cooldown spend+bind, Efreeti remove-stopper op, land grant-anchored hook (attempt 2)
description:
Repair attempt for capability eshyra-olc5.12, building on eshyra-olc5.12.1 (commit 9c0ed7b6, merged into branch eshyra-olc5.12; read its completion notes with bd show eshyra-olc5.12.1). Resolves follow-ups eshyra-k3nv and eshyra-qzc6 (read both) so F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' can land for both carriers. Branch eshyra-olc5.12.2 cut from eshyra-olc5.12 (SHA recorded at dispatch). Importer work: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; regenerate the pack with the repo script and commit the output.

CAPTAIN DECISIONS (follow; if any is wrong against the source or the code, STOP and report in notes instead of improvising):

1. Efreeti Bottle opening operation (qzc6). Source (magic-item description): "When you use an action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of the bottle ... an efreeti appears". Author one operation id 'remove-stopper', activation { cost: 'action' }, cost [{ economy: 'stopper', amount: 1 }] on the Efreeti Bottle projection, in the importer where its economy is authored (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemTriage.ts efreetiStopper ~L1558, or wherever operations for that record are assembled - follow existing patterns, e.g. how Ring of Djinni Summoning's 'summon-djinni' op is authored). Check how a 'cooldown'-kind economy without an explicit max initializes (Ring's cooldown economy is the precedent) so a fresh bottle starts with the stopper available. Do NOT model the d100 first-opening roll, the "next two times / fourth time" opening counter, or "bottle loses its magic" here: report in notes whether those stay as they are (randomProcedure / untyped) and that the new operation does not claim them. Give the new operation clause the correct engineHooks/readiness through the existing derivation, do not hand-write readiness.

2. Couple spend and grant (k3nv). In validateItemGrantBinding (packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts): when the grant names a cooldownEconomy, binding requires that economy on the item instance to be spent and not yet scheduled (remaining 0 and no availableAt; read it through the itemState helpers, not raw JSON), and refuses if another ACTIVE effect already binds the same itemInstanceId + grantId. Error text tells the DM to use_item the item's operation first. Grants without cooldownEconomy are unaffected (Figurines etc. keep binding as now; hostile-efreeti and wish-granting-efreeti too). In use_item (find the tool + state spend path), when a spent economy is the cooldownEconomy of a typed grant, add to the result a hint { bindGrant: <grantId> } and say in the use_item tool description that such a summon must then be bound with start_effect source.grantRef/itemInstanceId, and that its cooldown starts only when that bound effect ends. A spend that is never bound stays recoverable (DM binds late and ends it) - state this in notes, no extra mechanism.

3. Persistent actors vs encounter closure (from eshyra-c58j). Determine whether encounter closure (or any non-source path) ENDS a grant-bound summoning effect and therefore fires grant-ended early (e.g. a djinni that should last its hour beyond the fight). If it does, for grants whose entityGrant.runtimeOwner is 'persistent-actor', require the linked actor to carry a durable campaign actor (the existing campaignActorId / persistent link mechanism in encounterCombatants.ts / bonded-summon code) so closure does not end it, with a test. If closure does not end the effect, prove that with a test and say so in notes. If the existing machinery cannot do this without a new design, STOP and report.

4. Land F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCompiler.ts ~L350; replace the "Grant-ended anchors remain staged for olc5.12" comment with a one-line ownership comment like its neighbours) only after 1-3 hold for both carriers. Regenerate. Report the exact ready-operation delta (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady before/after) with a faithfulness note per newly-ready operation.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (extend packages/core/test/itemGrantSummons.test.ts, generated pack records):
- Ring: use_item summon-djinni -> result hint bindGrant particular-djinni -> start_effect binds -> djinni 0 HP ends -> cooldown availableAt = that moment + 24h -> after 24h the economy is available again (reset executor).
- Ring: start_effect bind WITHOUT prior spend refused; second concurrent bind of the same grant refused.
- Efreeti Bottle: fresh instance has the stopper available; use_item remove-stopper spends it; serving-efreeti bound, 1-hour expiry -> stopper availableAt = expiry + 24h; use_item remove-stopper refused during the wait and allowed after. hostile-efreeti binds without stopper coupling.
- Persistent-actor closure test per decision 3.
Keep every existing test passing; do not weaken any.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: what was authored in the pack (diff summary of records.json for Efreeti Bottle), coupling rule, closure finding, hooks landed, exact ready delta, verify result. Close eshyra-k3nv and eshyra-qzc6 with a reason citing your commit only if fully resolved; otherwise append notes to them.
notes:
Captain review of 9c0ed7b6: the olc5.12.1 conformance list omitted 'DM end_effect on an owner-command revert ends the grant'. Add it here: a Figurine of Wondrous Power grant (or another carrier whose revertOn is dm-ended, e.g. owner-command-while-touching / owner-dismisses-as-action) bound via start_effect, then end_effect reason 'ruled' with a note ends the effect and removes/vanishes the linked combatant per the existing lifecycle; plus a test that a grant-bound effect ended by end_effect fires the grant-ended anchor (Ring).
Dispatched 2026-10-15 as Claude Haiku 5.5 Agent subagent. Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.12.2, branch cut from eshyra-olc5.12 @ 9c0ed7b6.
COMPLETION REPORT (olc5.12.2, Haiku 5.5 dispatch). Commit b205724d on eshyra-olc5.12.2 (cut from 9c0ed7b6). Not pushed, no PR.

PACK AUTHORING (records.json diff, 2 records changed, 0 added/removed):
- magic-item:efreeti-bottle: mechanics.operations gains remove-stopper {activation:{cost:'action'}, cost:[{economy:'stopper', amount:1}]}; the existing stopper economy (cooldown, startsOn grant-ended serving-efreeti, 24 h, reset hour all) now has its spend. Clause c1-remove-stopper (block operations, engineHook F2 'olc5.11 pack-tested paid item operation', green). Clause m4-stopper goes engine-pending -> green.
- magic-item:ring-of-djinni-summoning: clause c1-cooldown goes engine-pending -> green (F5 grant-anchored hook landed). No other field changed.
- The d100 first-opening roll (M8), the opening counter and bottle-loses-magic are NOT modelled; they stay as before (randomProcedure, adjudicated). remove-stopper does not claim them.
- Census pins moved by the new op and landed hook (each +/-1 with its source reason): reviewed owner tags efreeti-bottle M8,M4,S -> +C1 (C1 105->106, audit doc and census test updated); activation census gets a remove-stopper row (357->358, verbatim printed sentence); backlog candidates 804->805 with fingerprint; readiness clauses 1376->1377 (engine-pending 792->790, green 223->226); inventory population counts for the F5/F2 hooks regenerated (docs/inventories o9bd-18-8-8, via inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts); landed-hook registry test updated.

COUPLING RULE (activeEffects.ts validateItemGrantBinding + itemState.ts):
- SCOPED DEVIATION from the captain text (needs your confirmation): the spend coupling applies only to grants whose cooldown economy is anchored to that grant (economy.cooldown.startsOn = grant-ended with this grantId; helper grantCooldownAnchoredTo). Reason: the literal rule ("binding requires remaining 0") is wrong against the source for multi-use economies. Bag of Tricks is per-day with 3 uses, so one pull leaves 2 and a legitimate bind would be refused. Pipes (charges), vessels (per-day uses), Horn (7-day cooldown, no anchor) and goat (hour charges) are the same. Their binds are unchanged (tests unchanged). Filed eshyra-olc5.12.3 for their remaining gap.
- Anchored grant bind requires the economy on the instance to be spent and unscheduled (remaining 0, no availableAt), else refused with "use_item '<op>' first" (Ring: summon-djinni; Efreeti: remove-stopper).
- Refused if another ACTIVE/SUSPENDED effect already binds the same itemInstanceId + grantId ("one spend starts one summon").
- use_item: when a spend charges the anchored grant's economy, the result carries hint { bindGrant: <grantId> }. The start_effect and use_item tool texts say the summon must be bound with source.grantRef/itemInstanceId, its cooldown starts only when the bound effect ends, and an unbound spend stays recoverable (the DM binds late). No extra mechanism.
- Recoverability is checked: an unbound spend leaves the economy depleted with no timer; a later bind schedules the wait on end.

CLOSURE FINDING (decision 3, probed and tested):
- Combat closure does NOT end a grant-bound summon. For an instance-only djinni (join_combat creatures, no campaignActorId), close_combat_instance releases the actor link (removed_reason combat-ended) and leaves the effect ACTIVE with no creature, so grant-ended would not fire until the 1 h timer. A combatant-owned concentration owner does end it (owner-removed), which is a printed-owner case, not this path.
- Landed fix: for runtimeOwner 'persistent-actor' grants (Ring, Efreeti bottle, Feather Token whip, Manual of Golems, Staff of the Python, Iron Flask, figurines, per pack data), each linked actor needs campaignActorId or a campaign-actor combatant identity, else refused "needs campaignActorId". With campaignActorId, closure rebinds the link to the campaign actor and the effect stays active.
- DISCREPANCY: eshyra-c58j says figurines are not in the persistent-actor set; the pack says runtimeOwner persistent-actor for all figurine grants. Applied the pack data (figurines included). Figurine tests pass (start_encounter actors are campaign actors).

HOOKS LANDED: F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' added to LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (magicItemCompiler.ts), staged comment replaced. Other grant hooks (F3 owned-entity lifecycle, F2 controlled-entity budget, F5 owned-entity identity link) NOT landed; they are the entityGrant clause's missing hooks and are unchanged.

READY-OPERATION DELTA (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady, before/after): ZERO operations newly ready.
- ring summon-djinni: before blocked by c1-cooldown (F5) and m4 entityGrant (F2/F3/F5); after blocked only by m4 entityGrant. Still not safely executable.
- efreeti remove-stopper: new op, blocked by m4 entityGrant (F2/F3/F5) and m8 randomProcedure (F1/F5/F9). Still not executable.
- Faithfulness note: none newly ready, so no newly-ready op needs a faithfulness review. Production use_item stays refused for both until entityGrant and randomProcedure hooks land (eshyra-c58j scope). Tests run on waivedPack as olc5.8 does.

CONFORMANCE (packages/core/test/itemGrantSummons.test.ts, 12 tests pass):
- Ring: unspent bind refused with use_item hint; spend returns hint bindGrant; bind ok; second concurrent bind of the same grant refused. 0 HP ends the grant: availableAt exactly 1440 (elapsed 0 + 24 h), reset after 24 h. DM end_effect ruled ends the grant and fires the wait (availableAt 1440, remaining 0 at 1439, 1 at 1440).
- Efreeti: fresh stopper remaining 1; unpaid serving bind refused; remove-stopper spends (costs, hint serving-efreeti); serving bind; 1 h expiry -> availableAt 1500 (60 + 1440); remaining 0 until 1500, 1 after. Hostile binds without stopper coupling.
- Persistent-actor closure: instance-only djinni bind refused without campaignActorId; durable bind survives close_combat_instance (effect active, campaign_actor link active).
- Existing tests kept: the Efreeti expiry test now spends the stopper first (required by the new coupling; expiry intent unchanged). Bag, Figurine, illusion, unmapped-revertOn, and concentration tests unchanged.

VERIFY: npm run verify:worktree exit 0 (364 files passed, 2 skipped; 6808 tests passed, 3 skipped). npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack: committed pack matches importer output exactly. Pack regenerated with npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1.

FOLLOW-UPS: eshyra-olc5.12.3 (P2, non-anchored multi-use grants bind without spend), eshyra-olc5.12.4 (P3, Efreeti hint on hostile/wish outcomes; first-opening roll and counter stay DM-adjudicated). Both were created with --parent eshyra-olc5.12, which links them as children of that bead. Not a modification of olc5.12 itself, but flagged.
